authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't reduce the deck to generic artifact combo without copy targets.
Don't add legendary artifacts that Ashad can't copy without a reason.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Vandalblast/Bane of Progress resets the board and the copy targets.
No power-2+ creature to sacrifice: no copy.

mitigations: Iron Man copies legendary artifacts as nonlegendary

value.interaction: Artifact hate is the main threat; keep counters (Mana Drain, Arcane Denial) and flexible removal.
value.mana: Artifact mana (Mox Opal, Urza's Saga, KCI) and 30+ lands.
value.protection: Greaves, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Padeem for artifacts.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Ashad copies one artifact spell per turn into a token and turns every sacrifice into a counter on himself.
accepted_role.honest_note: Once per turn and only nonlegendary artifact spells; the deck's artifact-sacrifice core (KCI, altars, Urza) would run under any Grixis artifact commander. Ashad is a strong value engine, not the deck's sole win source.
